title: sample-list/1: what the files hold, sample by sample
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli sample list --json`: one entry per file, in the order given. An entry is the `samples_list/1` document the site and the app also use (format, bytes, scan, samples with id, name, scans, size, kinds, polarity, rt, tic, why, refused), or, for a file the reader refuses, an `error/1` document. Exit 1 when a sample or a file is refused or a .wiff.scan is cut (the document stays on stdout); a file that is missing or unreadable is one `error/1` (exit 4). Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/samples_cmd.rs.
